# 82. Remove Duplicates from Sorted List II

## Solution 1 (O(n))

```python
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode(object):
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.next = None

class Solution(object):
    def deleteDuplicates(self, head):
        """
        :type head: ListNode
        :rtype: ListNode
        """
        dummy = ListNode(-1)
        dummy.next = head
        p = dummy
        is_repeat = False
        while p.next:
            while p.next.next and p.next.val == p.next.next.val:
                p.next = p.next.next
                is_repeat = True
            if is_repeat:
                p.next = p.next.next
                is_repeat = False
            else:
                p = p.next
        return dummy.next
```
